auth_access_model: Both packages are locally executable once installed: metasalmonpy resolves from the pinned git tag through uv, metasalmon installs into R from the pinned tag. Term retrieval needs network access to the published ontologies and external vocabularies. Optional LLM-review and publication actions depend on external credentials and are not exposed by this plugin.

discovery_search.note: Role-aware term search is exposed through `salmon-terms`, which calls metasalmonpy `find_terms()` and `sources_for_role()`.

metadata_schema.note: Package metadata, dictionaries, and validation workflows are core package features.

entity_lookup.note: The packages search semantic terms, but they are not an operational salmon identity graph.

identifier_crosswalks.note: The packages support semantic reconciliation and term requests, but not full operational crosswalk resolution.

abundance_assessment.note: The packages are not an assessment data platform.

telemetry_passage.note: The packages are not a telemetry platform.

hatchery.note: No hatchery-specific workflow is exposed in the current skills.

harvest_fishery.note: No harvest or fishery-specific workflow is exposed in the current skills.

genetics_gsi.note: No genetics or GSI-specific workflow is exposed in the current skills.

package_metadata_export.note: Package validation is exposed through `metasalmon-skill`; creation and export remain package-side and are not yet bridged from chat payloads.

provenance_versioning.note: Ontology fetch caching and package checks help, and the adapter reports whether the installed version matches the pin, but the plugin does not yet expose the full provenance and publication workflow.

bulk_access_api_ergonomics.note: The adapters are local package calls marshalled as JSON, not an external API wrapper.

blockers: The plugin exposes only a thin adapter surface: term lookup, ontology fetch, runtime and catalog inspection, and package validation.
metasalmonpy is not on PyPI; it resolves from a pinned git tag, so the first run needs network access to build the environment.
The interim R engine depends on a local R library with metasalmon installed at the pinned version.
governance_constraints: Adapters only marshal JSON to the pinned releases; package logic is never re-implemented in this repository.
LLM-assisted features and publication helpers depend on external provider setup and human review and are not exposed here.
Version bumps change this card and the script pins together.
watch_fields: latest release tag versus the pinned release
exported function signatures for find_terms, sources_for_role, fetch_salmon_ontology, validate_salmon_datapackage
Foundry salmon CLI availability (retires the interim R engine)
